source.section: Section 2 — OSI and TCP IP models

questions.sentence: The seven-layer reference model is called ___.
A running application is a ___, and its local communication endpoint abstraction is a ___.
questions.explanation: The process requests communication using sockets.

questions.sentence: The minimum connection identifier for established TCP uses two IP addresses and two ___.
questions.explanation: The four-tuple includes the source and destination ports.

source.section: Section 2 — OSI and TCP IP models

questions.sentence: An SMTP command must be parsed from a TCP byte ___ rather than from assumed message-sized reads.
questions.explanation: TCP does not preserve application message boundaries.

source.section: Section 2 — OSI and TCP IP models

questions.sentence: IP carries TCP in a packet; Ethernet carries IP in a ___.
questions.explanation: Encapsulation places the IP packet into a local link frame.

source.section: Section 2 — OSI and TCP IP models

questions.sentence: In the five-layer Internet model, DNS belongs to the ___ layer.
hints: The same broad layer as SMTP.
questions.explanation: DNS is an application protocol despite supporting other applications.

questions.sentence: The source port 49152 is an example of an ___ port.
questions.explanation: A client usually selects a local ephemeral port.

questions.sentence: The server operation that returns a connected socket while retaining a listener is ___.
questions.explanation: Accept returns the endpoint associated with an incoming connection.

source.section: Section 2 — OSI and TCP IP models

questions.sentence: Encoding and representation are associated with OSI layer ___, while transport is layer ___.
questions.explanation: OSI presentation is layer 6 and transport is layer 4.

source.section: Section 2 — OSI and TCP IP models

questions.sentence: TLS normally runs above ___ in the SMTP stack.
questions.explanation: TLS uses TCP in the SMTP examples.

questions.sentence: A mail relay usually starts a ___ TCP connection for the next SMTP transfer.
questions.explanation: The relay does not forward the original TCP stream unchanged.

questions.sentence: A browser commonly submits a webmail request using ___ rather than directly originating SMTP.
questions.explanation: The backend can handle later SMTP transfer.
